6:["$","p",null,{"children":"This guide covers everything you need to know about how Australia PR points work, what score you might need, and where to focus your efforts."}]
7:["$","h2",null,{"children":"What Are PR Points in Australia"}]
8:["$","p",null,{"children":"Australia PR points are a scoring system used to rank skilled migration applicants. When you want to apply for a skilled visa — such as the 189, 190, or 491 — you need to meet certain criteria, and each criterion is worth a set number of points."}]
9:["$","p",null,{"children":"The higher your total score, the more competitive your application becomes in the government's invitation rounds. Understanding Australia PR points is essential for anyone considering skilled migration, as it helps you identify which areas to improve before submitting your application."}]
a:["$","p",null,{"children":["You can explore the different visa types that use the points system on our"," ",["$","$L5",null,{"href":"/articles/189-vs-190-vs-491-visa-comparison","className":"text-blue-700 hover:underline font-medium","children":"189 vs 190 vs 491 visa comparison page"}],"."]}]
b:["$","h2",null,{"children":"How the PR Points System Works"}]
c:["$","p",null,{"children":"The process works in three main steps:"}]
d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 1: Calculate Your Points"}]
e:["$","p",null,{"children":"Go through each of the 12 categories and determine how many points you qualify for. Some categories are straightforward (like age), while others may require proof (like work experience or qualifications)."}]
f:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 2: Submit Your Expression of Interest (EOI)"}]
10:["$","p",null,{"children":"Once you have an idea of your score, you submit an EOI through SkillSelect — the Australian government's online system. Your EOI includes your points claim and other personal details."}]
11:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 3: Wait for an Invitation"}]
12:["$","p",null,{"children":"The government runs regular invitation rounds. They invite applicants with the highest scores first, sorted by occupation. If your score is competitive for your occupation, you may receive an invitation to apply for a visa."}]
13:["$","div",null,{"className":"bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg p-4 my-6","children":["$","p",null,{"className":"text-sm text-amber-800","children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Note:"}]," The PR points system Australia uses is subject to change. Always check the official Department of Home Affairs website for the most current rules."]}]}]

16:["$","h3",null,{"children":"1. Age (Up to 30 points)"}]

24:["$","h3",null,{"children":"5. Educational Qualifications (Up to 20 points)"}]

27:["$","h3",null,{"children":"6. Specialist Education Qualification (Up to 10 points)"}]

29:["$","h3",null,{"children":"7. Australian Study Requirement (5 points)"}]
2a:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you have completed at least 2 academic years (92 weeks) of study in Australia, you can claim 5 points."}]
2b:["$","h3",null,{"children":"8. Regional Study (5 points)"}]
2c:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you met the Australian study requirement while living and studying in a designated regional area, you may claim an additional 5 points. Distance education does not count."}]
2d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"9. Professional Year (5 points)"}]
2e:["$","p",null,{"children":"A professional year is a structured program available for Accounting, ICT, and Engineering graduates. It must be at least 12 months and completed in Australia."}]
2f:["$","h3",null,{"children":"10. Community Language (5 points)"}]
30:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you hold NAATI accreditation at the required level (paraprofessional or above), or a community language credential, you can claim 5 points."}]
31:["$","h3",null,{"children":"11. Partner Skills (Up to 10 points)"}]
32:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your partner's situation affects your score:"}]
33:["$","ul",null,{"children":[["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Partner has skills assessment + competent English:"}]," 10 points"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Partner has competent English only:"}]," 5 points"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Single or partner is Australian citizen/PR:"}]," 10 points"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Partner does not meet any criteria:"}]," 0 points"]}]]}]
34:["$","h3",null,{"children":"12. State Nomination (5 or 15 points)"}]
35:["$","p",null,{"children":"If you are applying for a nominated visa, you receive bonus points:"}]
